From permit request to the last lock off, one record for every hazardous job.

PermitWiseAI replaces the permit book, the isolation register and the incident file with one workflow. Work cannot start until approvals, gas tests and lockout are verified, and every step is signed by a named person.

Request access
See how it works

Onboarding is by invitation. We set up your organisation and first site with you.

One flow, from request to restoration

Each stage has an owner and a gate. The permit only moves forward when the gate is satisfied, and the status your whole site sees changes with it.

1
Raise the permit
Draft

Job issuer and executor

Choose the permit type, location, time window, crew and machinery. The HOD is notified as soon as a draft exists, not when it lands on their desk.

2
Clear conflicts
Pending approval

Automatic

SIMOPS compares location, schedule and hazards against every live and pending permit. A clash goes back to the HOD instead of out to the site.

3
Approve
Pending approval

HOD, then safety officer

The HOD reviews risk and priority, the safety officer reviews site conditions and gas readings. Either can send it back or reject it, and the reason is kept.

4
Isolate
Approved

Executor, verified by safety

A machine-specific LOTOTO plan walks through each energy source in order: lock, tag, try out, photograph. Work stays blocked until every point is verified.

5
Do the work
Active

Executor and crew

Time-stamped progress with photos. Pause, near-miss and accident reports sit on the same screen, and an accident stops the permit automatically. Multi-day jobs are revalidated every morning.

6
Restore and close
Closed

Executor, issuer, HOD

Isolations come off in sequence with evidence, the area is declared clear, and the issuer and HOD sign the permit off. The whole history stays attached.

Everything the permit touches, in the same system

People, machines, isolations, readings and incidents stay linked to the permit they belong to, so nothing has to be reconciled after the fact.

Plan the work
Permit types
Hot work, confined space, work at height and your own types, each with its own fields and colour.
SIMOPS
Automatic detection of overlapping work by location, schedule and hazard.
Gas testing
Readings recorded against the permit before approval and on revalidation.
Multi-day permits
Daily progress, daily safety revalidation, extensions and validity checks.
Control hazardous energy
LOTOTO plans
Isolation procedures per workstation and machine, covering every energy source.
Sequential lockout
Lock, tag and try-out steps enforced in order, each signed by a named person.
Evidence capture
Photos and logs stored with the step they prove.
Restoration
De-isolation verified step by step before equipment returns to service.
Respond and learn
Incidents and near misses
Reported from the job, linked to the permit, people and machine involved.
Investigations
Root cause, corrective actions and reminders when actions go overdue.
Notifications
In-app and email alerts for approvals, rejections, conflicts and expiring permits.
Dashboards and reports
Views for HODs, safety and management, with PDF, Excel and CSV exports.
Run the organisation
Master data
Departments, locations, workstations and machinery in one catalogue.
Workforce
Employees, contractors and agencies, with the roles they are allowed to hold.
Role authority
Issuer, executor, supervisor, safety officer, HOD and administrator, enforced on every action.
Subscriptions
Modules and usage managed per organisation.
What changes when the permit book goes digital

Safety comes first by design. The system will not let work begin until the mandatory steps are done, and it remembers who did each one.

Paper-based permits compared with PermitWiseAI
	Paper and spreadsheets	With PermitWiseAI
Approvals	Chasing signatures around the plant	Routed to the right HOD and safety officer, with reasons on record
Overlapping work	Discovered on the shop floor	Flagged by SIMOPS before anyone approves
Isolation proof	A tick in a register	Each lock, try-out and restoration signed and photographed
Multi-day jobs	Yesterday's permit reused without re-checks	Revalidated every day before work resumes
Audits	Days of digging through files	Complete history per permit, person and machine
Visibility	Phone calls to find out what is live	Live dashboards for every level of the site
Access and evidence you can defend in an audit

A permit is only worth the signatures on it. These are the controls behind every one.

Single sign-on

OpenID Connect sign-in, with a forced password change the first time an invited user logs in.

Enforced authority

Roles are checked on the server for every action, so a screen can never approve what its user may not.

Tenant isolation

Every record is scoped to its organisation. One customer's permits are never visible to another.

Audit trail

Who created, approved, rejected, locked or closed what, and when, kept with the permit.

Bring your first site online

Tell us about your plant. We will configure your organisation and invite your first administrator.

Privacy policy

Last updated 27 September 2026

This policy explains what personal data PermitWiseAI handles, why, and the choices you have. It is written for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the rules made under it.

1. Who is responsible for your data

ViXR India Private Limited, CIN [CIN], with its registered office at 7 & 8, 2nd Floor, 27th Main, HSR Sector 1, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 102 ("we", "us"), operates PermitWiseAI. Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act") we act in two different capacities:

As Data Fiduciaryfor personal data we collect for our own purposes: visitors to this website, people who request access, and the contact details of the people who manage our customers' accounts.
As Data Processor for everything our customers put into PermitWiseAI: permits, workforce records, isolation evidence, incident reports and the like ("Customer Data"). The customer organisation, usually your employer or the site owner, is the Data Fiduciary for that data and decides why and how it is processed. We process it only on their documented instructions.

If you use PermitWiseAI through your employer or a site you work at, please send requests about your Customer Data to that organisation first. We will help them respond.

2. Personal data we collect
Access requests: your name, work email, company, and, if you give them, your phone number, job title, number of sites and message.
Account data: name, email address, role, department, profile photo and sign-in history for each user an organisation invites.
Operational records within Customer Data: names and roles recorded on permits, approvals and rejections with their reasons, time-stamped progress entries, gas-test readings, photographs taken as isolation or work evidence, and incident and near-miss reports, which may include descriptions of injuries.
Technical data: IP address, browser and device information, and security and audit logs of actions taken in the service.
3. Why we use it
To respond to your access request and set up your organisation, based on your consent.
To provide, secure and support the service for the customer that invited you.
To keep the audit trail that makes a permit record trustworthy.
To send service messages such as invitations, approval requests and expiry reminders.
To comply with law, court orders and directions from authorities, which are legitimate uses under section 7 of the DPDP Act.

We do not sell personal data, and we do not use Customer Data to advertise to anyone.

4. Who we share it with
Authorised users of the same organisation, according to the roles the organisation assigns.
Service providers who host the service, store files and deliver email for us, bound by contract to process data only on our instructions and to protect it. [List of sub-processors, or a link to it.]
Authorities, where the law requires it, for example an accident report a customer is obliged to file.
5. Where your data is stored

Data is stored in India. If data is transferred outside India, it will only go to countries not restricted by the Central Government under section 16 of the DPDP Act, and under safeguards no weaker than those described here.

6. How long we keep it
Access requests that do not become customers are deleted [12 months] after our last contact.
Customer Data is kept for the subscription term and deleted within [90 days] after it ends, unless the customer asks us to export it first. Customers remain responsible for any statutory period they must keep safety records for.
Security logs are kept for at least 180 days, as required by the CERT-In directions of 28 April 2022.
Where you withdraw consent, or the purpose is no longer served, we erase the data unless the law requires us to keep it.
7. How we protect it

We apply reasonable security safeguards as required by section 8(5) of the DPDP Act, including encryption in transit, single sign-on, role-based access checked on the server for every action, separation of each organisation's data, and audit logging.

If a personal data breach occurs, we will notify the Data Protection Board of India and the affected people as the DPDP Act and its rules require, notify CERT-In within six hours of noticing a reportable cyber incident, and support our customers with their own notifications.

8. Your rights

Under the DPDP Act you can:

ask for a summary of the personal data we process about you and who we shared it with;
ask us to correct, complete, update or erase it;
withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it;
nominate another person to exercise your rights if you die or become incapacitated;
have your grievances addressed by our Grievance Officer.

Withdrawing consent does not affect processing that already took place. For data held as Customer Data, we will pass your request to the organisation responsible for it.

9. Children

PermitWiseAI is a workplace tool and is not meant for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe we have, contact us and we will delete it.

10. Contact and grievances

Privacy questions: info@permitwiseai.cloud

Grievance Officer: [Name of Grievance Officer], info@permitwiseai.cloud, 7 & 8, 2nd Floor, 27th Main, HSR Sector 1, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 102. We respond within the period prescribed under the DPDP Rules. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

11. Changes to this policy

We will post any change on this page and update the date at the top. If a change affects how we use data you consented to, we will ask for your consent again. See also our cookie policy and terms and conditions.

Please read these terms before using PermitWiseAI. They explain what we provide, what the Customer is responsible for, and how disputes are resolved.

1. The agreement

These terms form an agreement between ViXR India Private Limited("we", "us") and the organisation that subscribes to PermitWiseAI("Customer"). An order form or subscription agreement signed with us takes precedence over these terms where the two conflict.

If you accept these terms for an organisation, you confirm you have authority to bind it. Individual users use the service under their organisation's subscription.

2. Accounts and access
Organisation accounts are created by invitation after an access request is accepted.
The Customer's administrators decide who has access and which role each person holds, and must remove access promptly when someone leaves.
Each user must keep their credentials private. Actions taken with a user's account are treated as taken by that user, which is what makes the audit trail meaningful.
3. Safety responsibilities

PermitWiseAIis a tool for managing and recording safe systems of work. It does not replace competent persons, site risk assessments, or the Customer's legal duties.

The Customer remains responsible for complying with the laws that apply to its sites, including the Factories Act, 1948, the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, state rules, and any industry standards it has adopted.
The Customer configures permit types, approval routes, isolation plans and checklists, and is responsible for their adequacy for the hazards at its sites.
The Customer must keep a fallback procedure for issuing and closing permits and isolations if the service is unavailable, and must never delay an emergency response to use the service.
4. Customer data

The Customer owns the data it and its users put into the service ("Customer Data"). It grants us permission to host and process Customer Data only to provide, secure and support the service, and as described in our privacy policy. For personal data, the Customer is the Data Fiduciary and we are its Data Processor under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

The Customer is responsible for having a lawful basis to record its workforce's personal data, and for giving them any notices the law requires.

5. Acceptable use

The Customer and its users must not:

use the service in breach of law or to record information they have no right to record;
try to access another organisation's data or bypass role or tenant restrictions;
probe, overload or disrupt the service, or introduce malicious code;
resell, sublicense or copy the service, or reverse engineer it except as the law allows.
6. Fees and payment

Fees, modules and billing periods are set out in the order form. Fees exclude GST and other applicable taxes, which are charged in addition. Invoices are payable within [30] days. If an undisputed invoice is more than [30] days overdue, we may suspend the service after giving [15] days' written notice.

7. Availability and support

We aim to keep the service available [99.5]% of each month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced in advance. Support is available by email at info@permitwiseai.cloud during 10:00–18:00 IST, Monday to Friday. Any service credits are set out in the order form.

8. Intellectual property

We own the service, its software and its documentation. The Customer receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the service during the subscription. Feedback the Customer gives may be used to improve the service without obligation.

9. Confidentiality

Each party will protect the other's confidential information with at least reasonable care and use it only for this agreement. This does not apply to information that is public, already known, independently developed, or that must be disclosed by law.

10. Warranties and disclaimer

We will provide the service with reasonable skill and care and in line with its documentation. Apart from that, the service is provided "as is", and to the extent the law allows we disclaim all other warranties, including fitness for a particular purpose and uninterrupted or error-free operation.

11. Limitation of liability
Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit, revenue or goodwill.
Each party's total liability under this agreement is limited to the fees paid or payable by the Customer in the 12 months before the claim arose.
These limits do not apply to fraud, a breach of confidentiality, the Customer's payment obligations, or liability that cannot be limited by law.
12. Indemnities

We will defend the Customer against third-party claims that the service infringes their intellectual property. The Customer will defend us against third-party claims arising from Customer Data or from its use of the service in breach of these terms, including claims arising from work carried out at its sites.

13. Term and termination
The agreement runs for the subscription term in the order form and renews as stated there.
Either party may terminate if the other materially breaches it and does not fix the breach within 30 days of written notice.
After termination the Customer may export its data for [90] days, after which we delete it as described in the privacy policy.
14. Governing law and disputes

This agreement is governed by the laws of India. The parties will first try to settle any dispute through discussion between senior representatives. Failing that within 30 days, the dispute will be referred to a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seated in Bengaluru, in English. Subject to that, the courts at Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction.

15. General
Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
Neither party may assign the agreement without consent, except to a successor of its business.
If a clause is found unenforceable, the rest of the agreement continues to apply.
We may update these terms by posting a new version here. Changes that reduce the Customer's rights take effect at the next renewal, unless required by law sooner.
Notices to us: 7 & 8, 2nd Floor, 27th Main, HSR Sector 1, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 102, with a copy to info@permitwiseai.cloud.

Cookie policy

Last updated 27 September 2026

This policy lists every cookie and piece of browser storage PermitWiseAI uses.

1. What cookies and browser storage are

Cookies are small files a website saves in your browser. Local and session storage do a similar job inside the browser without being sent to the server on every request. We use both only where the service cannot work without them.

2. What we use

We use strictly necessary storage only. There are no advertising, analytics or third-party tracking cookies on this website or in the app.

Name	Type	Purpose	Lasts
ptw_access_token	Local storage	Keeps you signed in to the app	Until you sign out or it expires
ptw_refresh_token	Local storage	Renews your session without asking you to sign in again	Until you sign out or it expires
ptw-theme-preferences-v2	Local storage	Remembers your theme, density and light or dark mode	Until you clear it
ptw_nav_trail	Session storage	Lets Back links return to the page you came from	End of browser session
3. Consent

Strictly necessary storage is needed to provide the service you asked for, so we do not ask for separate consent for it. If we ever add analytics or other optional cookies, we will ask for your consent first and update this page.

4. Managing cookies

You can clear or block cookies and site data in your browser settings. If you do, you will be signed out and will need to sign in again. Blocking them entirely will stop sign-in from working.

5. Contact

Questions about this policy: info@permitwiseai.cloud. How we handle personal data is described in our privacy policy.
